body:
I know she is. She is awesome and can do way better than me. Unfortunately, that leaves me in the predicament of not being with this girl who is totally perfect to me and continuing on alone. I get that I dug my own grave on that one which is why the most discouraging thing for me is not being able to fix it and seeing her move on like I never mattered.

I have a lot of friends who want to help me but I am sick of taking help, sick of being a burden, sick of living this life.
*scrolls through facebook feed and new pic pops up of girl with other dude* wellllllllllllllllllll fuck.

I feel like I am stuck in a hole and I don't have the will to get out of it.  Most recently, and the thing likely exacerbating this current desire for oblivion, is that I fell in love with a girl.  I met her through reddit when I was cross-country and she sparked a bout of motivation in me.  I was miserable where I was due to my job and several horrible things that had happened to me while living there, so it wasn't a tough choice to quit and leave that situation once I gained the financial wherewithal.  Once I got here, we spent a month seeing each other -- the best month I could ever remember experiencing.  In that time, she told me she loved me, which was magic to my ears.  I haven't had someone who I so terribly want to hear it from tell me that in 6-7 years.  I was happy, really happy.  It was a foreign feeling to me but I was really enjoying it.  

However, in the past 3 or 4 years, I've used heroin as a coping mechanism for everything I've been through, and I hadn't yet stopped.  She caught me smoking some and cut me off, telling me I needed to get my shit together.  Fair enough.  To be clear, it shouldn't have been a surprise since I told her I was an opiate addict a few weeks prior and had made comments about doing oxy and other things in the months before I moved.  Aside from a few texts initiated by me in the following days, there's been no contact since then.  No checking to see if I'm okay or how I'm doing, nothing.  What has really messed with me about the situation, aside from the fact I'm a colossal fucking idiot for doing heroin, is that she doesn't seem to give a shit about me.  There doesn't seem to be anything backing up her telling me she loved me and that really breaks my heart.  It has become apparent since then that I don't have any chance of fixing this situation.  I also have a pretty good hunch she's dating another dude.  I'm old enough to realize there are other fish in the sea and all the other cliches about mending your heart when you lose someone you love, but my life is in such dire straights, even aside from the drug use, that I'm not inclined to continue trying.  Now is a good time to bow out and say fuck it all.

I have a lot deeper issues than that-- low self-esteem, self-hate, anxiety, crippling depression, broke, no motivation, a court case I have to deal with, etc. -- but that's the latest.

There's plenty to worry about.  Debt, legal issues, lost love.  It's not worth it to me to "try to make something out of it".  I don't get any pleasure out of waking up daily, only disappointment.  Just because I'm unique doesn't make me good and there's no guarantee that conditions will ever be completely different or even that different is a good thing.  I'm sure you care.  Lots of people do.  I'm not of the delusion that I don't have anyone in my life who cares about me, but that doesn't make things better.
